shape.description: A 1-D integer Tensor or Python array. The shape of the output tensor.

mean.description: A 0-D Tensor or Python value of type `dtype`. The mean of the truncated normal distribution.

stddev.description: A 0-D Tensor or Python value of type `dtype`. The standard deviation of the normal distribution, before truncation.

dtype.description: The type of the output. Restricted to floating-point types: `tf.half`, `tf.float`, `tf.double`, etc.

seed.description: A Python integer. Used to create a random seed for the distribution. See `tf.random.set_seed` for more information.

output.description: A tensor of the specified shape filled with random truncated normal values.
